name: turbo
description: Makes Claude Code faster, smarter and safer in any project: an indexed code MCP server (repo map, file outlines, symbol jumps, folded reads of huge files, ripgrep search, syntax checks), hooks that verify every edit and re-verify at stop, guards against large-file rewrites and destructive commands, a session briefing, plus skills and subagents for orienting, surgical patching, debugging, verification, smoke testing and handoff.
